info.name: Datadog Get Billing Dimension Mapping for Usage Endpoints

params.name: filter[month]
params.description: Datetime in ISO-8601 format, UTC, and for mappings beginning this month. Defaults to the current month.

params.name: filter[view]
params.description: String to specify whether to retrieve active billing dimension mappings for the contract or for all available mappings. Allowed views have the string `active` or `all`. Defaults to `active`.

items.docs:
Get a mapping of billing dimensions to the corresponding keys for the supported usage metering public API endpoints.
Mapping data is updated on a monthly cadence.

This endpoint is only accessible to [parent-level organizations](https://docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/multi_organization/).
